I plan on working on it.  It's actually blocking any further testing.
INFO 13:27:34.008 (FedoraVersioning) Request to add version 'imported-version-10' for 'migrated-fedora3/islandora/6'

This is because the RELS-INT contains RDF and really should be applied to the appropriate resource.  By mimicing what we're doing with RELS-EXT, I'm running into an issue where we're trying to apply RDF properties to the old fedora 3 pid, and not the new path in fedora 4.
This is what's tossing in the monkey wrench.
I'll see if I can take advantage of our ID mapper to try and resolve the appropriate resource.
Embarassingly, that blob of RDF has no namespace for width and height...  Way to go Islandora....
That's out of scope of this ticket, but figuring out how to apply RDF to the appropriate NonRDFSourceDescription still seems like a good idea.
Applies RDF properties in RELS-INT to the appropriate datastream.
Can you take a look at this Mike?
It seems you're working this issue.
It seems the purpose of this issue has changed a little from its original heading, right?
Would it be fair to characterize the goal of this effort as "Treat RELS-INT datastream as RDF during migration."?  If so, could you:
1.  change the label on this ticket
3.  click "stop work" (describe that you've finished it)
And then I'll review it with an eye towards that newly stated purpose.
Added example foxml file in PR for testing.

comments.body: Former user, are you planning on working this, or have you mentioned it to Michael Durbin?
I plan on working on it. It's actually blocking any further testing.

Error from catalina.out:

INFO 13:27:33.972 (FedoraLdp) GET resource 'migrated-fedora3/islandora/6/RELS-INT/fcr:metadata'
INFO 13:27:34.008 (FedoraVersioning) Request to add version 'imported-version-10' for 'migrated-fedora3/islandora/6'

This is because the RELS-INT contains RDF and really should be applied to the appropriate resource. By mimicing what we're doing with RELS-EXT, I'm running into an issue where we're trying to apply RDF properties to the old fedora 3 pid, and not the new path in fedora 4.

<rdf:Description rdf:about="info:fedora/islandora:6/JP2"><width>4081</width><height>5132</height></rdf:Description>

This is what's tossing in the monkey wrench.

I'll see if I can take advantage of our ID mapper to try and resolve the appropriate resource.

Embarassingly, that blob of RDF has no namespace for width and height... Way to go Islandora....

That's out of scope of this ticket, but figuring out how to apply RDF to the appropriate NonRDFSourceDescription still seems like a good idea.

PR for this: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/migration-utils/pull/6

Applies RDF properties in RELS-INT to the appropriate datastream.
Can you take a look at this Mike?

It seems the purpose of this issue has changed a little from its original heading, right?

Would it be fair to characterize the goal of this effort as "Treat RELS-INT datastream as RDF during migration."? If so, could you:
1. change the label on this ticket
2. click "start work"
3. click "stop work" (describe that you've finished it)

And then I'll review it with an eye towards that newly stated purpose.

Added example foxml file in PR for testing.
